login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your teaching workspace.
login.rememberHint: Leave this unticked on a shared device, and log out when you finish. Otherwise the next person who opens the app is signed in as you.
login.failed: Couldn't sign in with this username and password
login.failedHint: Check both and try again. After many failed attempts in a row, signing in pauses for a while. If you forgot your password, see “Forgot your password?” below.
login.rateLimitedHintNoWait: Wait a few minutes, then try again.
login.networkErrorHint: Check your connection, then try again.
login.serverError: Couldn't sign you in because of a server error
login.serverErrorHint: Try again in a few minutes.
login.forgotStudent: Students: message your tutor. They will reset it and give you a temporary password; at your next sign-in you choose a new one.
login.forgotTutor: Tutor: reset your password with the server's operator guide (the tutor password reset command).

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.forcedDescription: Choose a new password before you continue. Your current password is the temporary one you just signed in with.
changePassword.voluntaryDescription: After the change, you are signed out on every other device.
changePassword.newHint: 10 to 128 characters. Not a common password and not your username.
changePassword.networkError: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection, then try again.
changePassword.serverError: Couldn't change your password because of a server error. Try again in a few minutes.
changePassword.successBody: You were signed out on your other devices. Next time, sign in with your new password.

errors.confirmMismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The new password needs at least 10 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The new password can have at most 128 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: This password is too common and easy to guess. Choose another one.
errors.PASSWORD_EQUALS_USERNAME: The new password can't be your username.
errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password must differ from the current one.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.description: This page belongs to another role's area.
forbidden.descriptionTutor: This page is part of the student area.
forbidden.descriptionStudent: This page is for your tutor.
